capabilities: Edit rich text without Markdown syntax
Group many pages in one notepad file
Comment on selected text in threads
disambiguation: Not a Markdown editor; it is a separate WYSIWYG editor for .note and .um files inside the vault.
extras: Ships as a single main.js of about 6 MB because the Mermaid engine is bundled; Obsidian Sync on the Standard plan will not transfer the plugin folder (5 MB limit), so it must be installed on each device. Experimental options include dependent sub-tasks (off by default) and a diagnostic log. Beta versions available via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian notes are plain Markdown, so creating structured rich text documents with tables, comments, and formatting requires writing Markdown syntax.
summary: Local-first WYSIWYG rich text editor for structured documents, with notepads, comments, tables, and Mermaid diagrams.
